    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is OSRS Grand Exchange flipping?

    Grand Exchange flipping in Old School RuneScape is a money-making method where you buy items at a low price and sell them at a higher price for profit. 07Flip helps you find the best flip opportunities by showing real-time margins, profit calculations, and confidence scores.

    How often are the OSRS prices updated?

    07Flip updates prices every 30 seconds using official data from the OSRS Wiki Real-Time Prices API. Only items with both buy and sell data within the last 30 minutes are shown to ensure accurate margins.

    What is the confidence score in 07Flip?

    The confidence score (0-100) indicates how reliable a flip opportunity is. It considers trading volume (40%), price volatility (30%), spread percentage (20%), and data freshness (10%). Higher scores mean more reliable flips.

    Does 07Flip account for GE tax?

    Yes, all profit calculations include the 2% Grand Exchange tax (capped at 5M GP per item). Tax-exempt items like bonds are handled correctly.
